baseline.sync: HEAD already contained freshly fetched origin/main before development; fetched again before final validation on 2026-11-24 UTC.

prior_checkpoint_rerun.summary: The committed thirty-four-case patch was rebuilt in this worktree and passed three repeats with both Servo controls before any change.

negative_controls.name: interrupt-callback-disabled
negative_controls.variation: The script-thread interrupt callback ignored closed permits. The watcher, host cancellation, and the permit check before execution remained active.
negative_controls.expected_failure: Unexpected result: value String("1003") instead of String("2"). Host cancellation delivered Cancelled, but the loop completed, the finally block ran, and the trailing increment executed.

negative_controls.name: execution-check-disabled
negative_controls.variation: Only the permit check before execution was disabled. The watcher and interrupt callback remained active.
negative_controls.expected_failure: Unexpected result: value String("1") instead of String("0") in queued-engine-cancellation. Asynchronous interruption did not stop straight-line queued code, so the execution check remains necessary.

fixture_defects: The first build declared a top-level const in an interrupted script. Global lexical bindings persist, so a later evaluation failed with a redeclaration error. The final fixture uses block scopes.

A 300 ms lower bound for the uninterrupted loop failed in three of six diagnostic repeats at 299.3 to 299.8 ms. Date.now() has millisecond precision. The final bound is 250 ms, which still spans many 10 ms watcher intervals.
preliminary_validation.observation: Before assertion, a diagnostic run reported the prior microtask as run and the zero-delay timer as not yet run at the first query. The final fixture asserts the microtask immediately and waits for the timer.

local_validation.patch_reproduction: All fourteen patched engine files from a fresh preparation match the development sources byte for byte. Only the script_thread.rs patch section changed.
local_validation.product_changes: No product source, manifest, lockfile, installed native, or dependency version changes.
